title: Polynomial Derivative
explanation: Apply the Power Rule to each term: 3x⁴ becomes 12x³, -5x³ becomes -15x², 2x² becomes 4x, -7x becomes -7, and the constant 4 becomes 0.

title: Quadratic Equation
explanation: Factor the quadratic: x² - 7x + 12 = (x - 3)(x - 4). Setting each factor equal to zero gives x = 3 and x = 4.

title: Limit Evaluation
explanation: Factor the numerator: x² + 3x - 10 = (x - 2)(x + 5). Cancel x - 2, leaving x + 5. Substituting x = 2 gives 7.

title: Simplifying a Rational Expression
explanation: Factor the numerator using the difference of squares: x² - 9 = (x - 3)(x + 3). Cancel the common factor x - 3, leaving x + 3.

title: Product Rule
problem: Find the derivative of y = x² sin(x).
explanation: Using the Product Rule, (uv)' = u'v + uv'. Let u = x² and v = sin(x). Then u' = 2x and v' = cos(x), giving y' = 2x sin(x) + x² cos(x).

title: Chain Rule
explanation: Using the Chain Rule, differentiate the outer power first: 5(3x² + 1)⁴. Then multiply by the derivative of the inner function, 6x. Therefore y' = 30x(3x² + 1)⁴.

title: System of Equations
problem: Solve the system: 2x + y = 7 and x - y = 2.
explanation: Add the two equations: (2x + y) + (x - y) = 7 + 2, giving 3x = 9. Thus x = 3. Substitute x = 3 into x - y = 2 to get y = 1.

title: Exponent Laws
explanation: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents: x³ · x⁵ = x⁸. When dividing, subtract the exponents: x⁸/x² = x⁶.
